overview_description.description:
HomeLane is a home interior company that helps buyers do their home interiors in a personalized way. With more than 21000 projects delivered across the country, they come with huge experience in helping customers build their dream home. HomeLane offers personalized design services to all its customers at no extra cost.

HomeLane was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka.
